analysis.summary: Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Limited reported a strong first half of FY27, with pre-sales reaching INR879 crores and significant revenue and EBITDA growth. Management remains confident in meeting its FY27 guidance of INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores in pre-sales, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60%. The company expanded its project pipeline with three new additions during the quarter and plans four additional launches in H2 FY27. Backed by a net cash position of INR494 crores, the company continues to pursue redevelopment opportunities in the Mumbai housing and commercial markets. Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Limited reported a strong financial and operational performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, driven by robust pre-sales growth and expansion in key Mumbai micro-markets.

guidance.claim: The company remains confident of delivering its FY27 guideline of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores.
guidance.quote: Together with the momentum from our recent launches and a growing pipeline, we remain confident of delivering our FY27 guideline of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60% over FY26 levels.

guidance.claim: Management expects EBITDA and PAT margins to be 35% to 40% and 25% to 30% respectively for FY27.
guidance.quote: We also remain confident of sustaining strong profitability, with EBITDA and PAT margin expected at 35% to 40% and 25% to 30%, respectively.

guidance.claim: The company remains confident of achieving its FY27 guidance of pre-sales between INR 1,800 Crs and INR 2,000 Crs.
guidance.quote: We remain confident of delivering our stated guidance for FY27 of a pre-sales of INR 1,800-2,000 Crs, and revenue and PAT growth of 55-60% over FY26 levels.

guidance.claim: The company remains committed to its FY27 guidance of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 to 2,000 crores, alongside revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.
guidance.quote: Backed by this launch pipeline, strong demand outlook, and the quality of our developments, we remain committed to our FY27 guidance of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 to 2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident of sustaining strong profitability with EBITDA and PAT margins expected at 35% to 40% and 25% to 30%, respectively.
guidance.quote: We remain confident of sustaining strong profitability with EBITDA and PAT margins expected at 35% to 40% and 25% to 30%, respectively.

demand_outlook.claim: Mumbai remains India's largest housing market with sales in the first nine months of calendar 2026 at their highest since 2018.
demand_outlook.quote: Mumbai remains India’s largest housing market, with sales in the first nine months of calendar 2026 at their highest since 2018, and the luxury segment continues to lead.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand is driven largely by end users upgrading to larger homes in better locations.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand is driven largely by end users upgrading to larger homes in better locations, while scarce land in prime micromarkets makes redevelopment the principal route to new supply, precisely where Lotus has built its capability.

demand_outlook.claim: Pre-sales for Q2 FY27 grew by 83% year-on-year to INR 470 Crs, reflecting sustained demand for the company's premium offerings.
demand_outlook.quote: Pre-sales for Q2 FY27 grew 83% YoY to INR 470 Crs.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand is spread across the portfolio rather than resting on a single project.
demand_outlook.quote: Q2 FY27 pre-sales grew 83% YoY to INR 470 Crs, with six projects contributing, which shows that demand is spread across the portfolio rather than resting on a single project.

demand_outlook.claim: There is strong demand from financial institutions, fintech firms, and allied sectors for Grade-A commercial spaces in the GIFT City project.
demand_outlook.quote: Strong demand from financial institutions, fintech firms, and allied sectors for Grade-A commercial spaces, coupled with differentiated project positioning and strong brand name translating into high enquiry levels for luxury residential units.

demand_outlook.claim: Luxury housing demand across Mumbai has grown by more than 11%, led by successful families and professionals upgrading.
demand_outlook.quote: While most buyers globally are being cautious, given interest rates and broader uncertainty, luxury buyers are not. They are driven by long-term wealth creation, family legacy, and lifestyle, not by loan rates.

demand_outlook.claim: Supply in micro-markets like Worli, Bandra, and South Mumbai remains constrained with very little fresh land left.
demand_outlook.quote: At the same time, supply in micro-markets like Worli, Bandra, and South Mumbai remain constrained.

demand_outlook.claim: Average selling price stood at INR86,000 per square foot.
demand_outlook.quote: Our average selling price stood at INR86,000 per square foot, underscoring the strength of our product across the micro-markets we operate in.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is seeing encouraging inquiry levels across both launched projects, Lotus Trident and Lotus Aquaria.
demand_outlook.quote: During the quarter, we launched two projects, Lotus Trident in Andheri West and Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi towards the end of June 2026, and we are seeing encouraging inquiry level across both projects.

demand_outlook.claim: Pricing in the company's micro-market is running 10% to 15% higher than other developers.
demand_outlook.quote: So, regarding the pricing related to other developers, so normally in our micro-market we are getting 10% to 15% higher than the other developers.

capex_expansion.claim: The company added three new projects during the quarter: Lotus Impressa, Lotus Stellar, and Lotus Supremus.
capex_expansion.quote: Three new projects added, Lotus Impressa at Shivaji Park in Dadar West, Lotus Stellar in Versova, and Lotus Supremus in Juhu, which adds INR2,700 to INR2,800 crores of GDV to existing GDV pipeline.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans to launch four projects in the second half of the year: Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead, we are well-prepared for the second half. We plan to launch four projects, Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to INR4,000 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company was appointed as preferred developer for three new projects adding INR 2,700-2,800 Crs of GDV.
capex_expansion.quote: We also made significant progress on business development during the quarter, where company was appointed as preferred developer for three new projects: Lotus Supremus (Juhu), Lotus Empressa (Shivaji Park, Dadar West), Lotus Stellar (Versova) and additional area secured for Lotus Insignia which together adds INR 2,700-2,800 Crs of GDV.

capex_expansion.claim: The GIFT City project has an estimated GDV of INR 2,000-2,200 Crs and is expected to commence in Q1 FY28 with completion slated for FY31.
During the quarter, the company launched two new projects, Lotus Trident in Andheri and Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi, representing a combined GDV of INR1,350 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: During the quarter, we launched two new projects, Lotus Trident in Andheri and Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi, together representing a combined GDV of INR1,350 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company was appointed developer for a commercial redevelopment project in Juhu with an estimated GDV of INR1,600 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We were also recently appointed developer for a very, very prestigious commercial redevelopment project with an estimated GDV of INR1,600 crores in Juhu.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans to launch four more projects over the remainder of FY27 with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to 4,000 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead, we plan to launch four more projects over the remainder of FY27: Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to 4,000 crores.

margins_costs.claim: In Q2, total revenue rose 53% year-on-year to INR269 crores while EBITDA more than doubled to INR107 crores with margins expanding to 39.9%.
margins_costs.quote: In Q2, total revenue rose 53% year-on-year to INR269 crores. EBITDA more than doubled to INR107 crores, with margins expanding to 39.9%.

margins_costs.claim: H1 FY27 PAT stood at INR134 crores with an improved PAT margin of 33.5%.
margins_costs.quote: For the first half, revenue stood at INR401 crores, up 69%, EBITDA at INR155 crores, up 95%, and PAT at INR134 crores, up 86% at an improved PAT margin of 33.5%.

margins_costs.claim: In Q2, total revenue rose 53% YoY to INR 269 Crs, EBITDA more than doubled to INR 107 Crs at a margin of 39.9%, and PAT grew 91% to INR 89 Crs.
margins_costs.quote: In Q2, total revenue rose 53% YoY to INR 269 Crs, EBITDA more than doubled to INR 107 Crs at a margin of 39.9%, and PAT grew 91% to INR 89 Crs.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q2 FY27 stood at 39.9%.
PAT margin for Q2 FY27 was 33.0%.
Profit after tax grew 77% year-on-year to INR46 crores, at a PAT margin of 34.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax grew 77% year-on-year to INR46 crores, at a PAT margin of 34.5%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA stood at INR48 crores with an EBITDA margin of 36.4%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR48 crores, growing 63% year-on-year with a healthy EBITDA margin of 36.4%.

orders_capacity.claim: The ongoing and upcoming pipeline comprises 24 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR20,000 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: With these additions, our ongoing and upcoming pipeline now comprises 24 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR20,000 crores, of which 19 are redevelopment-led.

orders_capacity.claim: Lotus Trident contributed pre-sales of INR178 crores in its first full quarter since launch.
orders_capacity.quote: Lotus Trident in Andheri West, our luxury commercial offering, has been a standout performer, contributing pre-sales of INR178 crores in its first full quarter since its launch at the end of June.

orders_capacity.claim: For H1 FY27, pre-sales stood at INR 879 Crs, up 176% YoY.
orders_capacity.quote: For H1 FY27, pre-sales stood at INR 879 Crs, up 176% YoY and on track to achieve our full-year guidance.

orders_capacity.claim: Lotus Trident led commercial pre-sales with INR 178 Crs in its first full quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: Lotus Trident, our premium commercial launch in Andheri West, led with INR 178 Crs (~38% of pre-sales) in its first full quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: Pre-sales for the quarter stood at INR409 crores, up by 567% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: Pre-sales stood at INR409 crores, up by 567% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: The ongoing and upcoming pipeline comprises 22 projects, with 17 being redevelopment-led.
orders_capacity.quote: Our ongoing and upcoming pipeline comprises 22 projects, 17 residential and 5 commercial, with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR17,500 to 18,000 crores. Notably, 17 of these 22 projects are redevelopment-led, reinforcing our core focus and competitive strength in this segment.

capital_allocation.claim: As of September 30, 2026, the company had a net cash position of INR494 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As of 30th September 2026, we had a net cash position of INR494 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company raised approximately INR792 crores through the fresh issue of its IPO with net proceeds of approximately INR732 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We raised approximately INR792 crores through the fresh issue of our IPO, with net proceeds of approximately INR732 crores after issue expenses, of which INR550 crores earmarked for our subsidiary for the Amalfi, Arcadian, and Varun.

capital_allocation.claim: IPO proceeds of INR 550 Crs were allocated toward part-funding development and construction costs of ongoing projects Amalfi, The Arcadian, and Varun.
capital_allocation.quote: Investment in our Subsidiaries, Richfeel Real Estate Private Limited, Dhyan Projects Private Limited and Tryksha Real Estate Private Limited for part-funding development and construction cost of our Ongoing Projects, Amalfi, The Arcadian and Varun, respectively amounting to ~INR 550 Crs.

capital_allocation.claim: As of June 2026, the company had a cash balance of approximately INR776 crores against debt of INR153 crores, resulting in a net cash position of INR623 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As of June 2026, we had a total cash balance of approximately INR776 crores against debt of INR153 crores, resulting in a net cash position of INR623 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Projected free cash flow from completed and ongoing projects stands at approximately INR3,245 crores, while upcoming projects are expected to generate approximately INR5,240 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Our projected free cash flow from the completed and ongoing projects at approximately INR3,245 crores, while upcoming projects are expected to generate approximately INR5,240 crores, taking the total projected surplus to approximately INR8,485 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Out of INR550 crores earmarked for the subsidiary towards Amalfi, Arcadian, and Varun, INR271 crores has been deployed as on 30th June 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Of the INR550 crores earmarked for our subsidiary towards Amalfi, Arcadian, and Varun, we have deployed INR271 crores as on 30th June 2026, and the utilization remains in line with our planned deployment schedule.

risks_headwinds.claim: Earlier in the month, RBI raised the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.5%, its first increase since early 2023.
risks_headwinds.quote: Earlier this month, RBI raised the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.5%, its first increase since early 2023.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains committed to its FY27 guidance of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 to 2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.
